text.2:155: And surely We shall try you with something of fear and hunger, and loss of wealth and lives and crops; but give glad tidings to the steadfast,
text.16:112: Allah coineth a similitude: a township that dwelt secure and well content, its provision coming to it in abundance from every side, but it disbelieved in Allah's favours, so Allah made it experience the garb of dearth and fear because of what they used to do.
text.88:7: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
text.106:4: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
